statement: The surveyed xwiimote-ng fork retains xwiimote's userspace event-interface architecture on Linux, including XWII_IFACE_MOTION_PLUS and evdev opens. As a related maintained or modernized fork it may provide a second integration baseline, but it is not an independent raw Wii HID MotionPlus decoder and shares the hid-wiimote dependency. Runtime and exact compatibility with the existing xwiimote ABI were not verified.

applicability.revision: Pinned software consumer; retail Wii Remote revision not measured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer; xwiimote-ng fecc8db lib/core.c; source-derived fork architecture, not a separate physical protocol proof.
